resources.string: ✅ libisolation_jni.so was loaded from this plugin\'s own nativeLibraryDir, not the host\'s.
✅ Read from this plugin\'s AssetManager via toolContext.assets, not the host\'s.
This tool lives in the :isolation APK. It verifies cross-APK classloader isolation, native .so loading from plugin nativeLibraryDir, and plugin AssetManager via toolContext.assets.
